ideas.description: Build the first real recipe in submissions/arena/: an airbench96-style net without TTA. Settings: frozen patch-whitening conv (2x2, fit in prepare on real train images), dirac init, widths 128/384/576, depth 3 per block, BatchNorm-bias lr x64, Nesterov SGD lr 9 / wd 0.012 / bs 1024, label smoothing 0.3, lookahead, alternating flip plus translate-2 on GPU. The whole train set lives on the GPU as uint8 and is loaded in prepare. Use channels_last with bf16/fp16 autocast. torch.compile and warmup run in build() on synthetic data, covering the full batch, the final partial batch and eval shapes. Train for 10 epochs. Eval is a plain forward with no TTA and must handle any B from 1 to 1024.
ideas.expected: First feasible run. Accuracy 0.752-0.765 (point estimate ~0.758), time 9-14 s, against 59.3 s for the ResNet9 baseline. If accuracy is below 0.753, the next step is 11 epochs.

ideas.description: Same recipe as the H1.1.1 base. Change only the epoch count: 8.5 instead of 10 (same schedule shape, scaled to the shorter run). This tests whether the published 8.5-epoch figure holds without TTA.
ideas.expected: Accuracy drops ~0.6-1.0 pp from the 10-epoch run, to about 0.744-0.752 (infeasible). Time drops ~15%. Confirms that the missing TTA costs about 1 epoch.

ideas.description: Third point of the epoch sweep on the base recipe: 9 epochs, or 11 if the 10-epoch run missed 0.753. Fit accuracy against epochs with the 8.5 and 10 points and find the knee at 0.753 to within 0.5 epochs.
ideas.expected: Accuracy rises roughly linearly at about 0.4-0.6 pp per epoch. 9 epochs gives about 0.753-0.756: feasible with ~10% less time than 10 epochs, or a near-miss that pins the knee at about 9.3.

ideas.description: Rerun the feasible base recipe unchanged (identical commit config, fixed seeds 0-2) to measure the run-to-run noise floor from nondeterministic kernels and timing jitter.
ideas.expected: Accuracy within 0.15 pp and time within 3% of the original run. This sets the inconclusive threshold for later comparisons and the safety margin needed above 0.753.

ideas.description: Base recipe at its knee epoch count, with label smoothing 0.2 instead of 0.3. Nothing else changes.
ideas.expected: Accuracy drops ~0.3-0.5 pp and time is unchanged. Confirms LS 0.3 for CIFAR-100. If the drop is under 0.15 pp, mark it inconclusive.

ideas.description: Base recipe at its knee epoch count with lookahead removed: plain Nesterov SGD, no weight averaging. Same lr, wd and schedule.
ideas.expected: Accuracy drops ~0.3-0.6 pp (worth about 1 epoch) and per-seed spread widens. Time falls slightly (<2%) from skipping the averaging step. Confirms lookahead is worth keeping.

ideas.description: Explore: on the base recipe, switch the 4D conv filters to Muon (Newton-Schulz orthogonalized momentum, lr ~0.24, momentum 0.6, nesterov). Biases, BatchNorm and the head stay on Nesterov SGD. Use batch size 2000 with linear decay to zero, and keep the epoch count at the SGD knee.
ideas.expected: At equal epochs, accuracy is +0.3 to +0.8 pp, so 1-1.5 fewer epochs are needed and time is ~10-15% lower at the knee. Risk: Newton-Schulz overhead and a large-batch accuracy drop could cancel the gain.

ideas.description: Explore: on the feasible base, run the first ~35% of epochs on 24 px random crops and the rest at full 32 px. Compile both resolutions in build(). Same epoch count as the knee.
ideas.expected: Time falls ~8-12%. Accuracy drops 0.2-0.5 pp. Net gain only if adding back ≤0.5 epoch recovers 0.753.

structured_output.summary: So far there is only the harness smoke test (E000: chance accuracy, ~0.1 s fixed overhead per trial), so the queue opens with a real recipe. The top idea (H1.1.1, priority 5) is an airbench96-style net without TTA at 10 epochs, with data and augmentation on the GPU and compile done in build(). It is expected to land at about 0.758 accuracy in 9-14 s. Two ideas then map the epoch knee (H1.1.2 at 8.5 epochs, H1.1.3 at 9 or 11 epochs). A rerun of the base measures the noise floor (H4.1.1). Two single-change ablations follow: label smoothing 0.2 vs 0.3 (H1.3.1) and removing lookahead (H4.2.1). The last two are explore bets: Muon on the conv filters (H1.2.1) and progressive resizing (H2.3.1). The queue was empty, so nothing is dropped.
